title: The Clay Animals and a Lonely Lump
youtube_title: The Clay Animals and a Lonely Lump | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Staying beside someone is sometimes the whole gift.
summary: At a bedroom rug of cushions, puppets, and paper, Nia is just outside the fun, close to a lump of clay not yet given to the friend without one. Ines changes the seating, the rules, or the pace so Nia has a real place, not a prize announced out loud. Papa lets the children solve it.
